raw: {"title":"水平与斜抛运动同时分解模型","domain":"projectile","model_js":"globalThis.coursewareModel=Object.freeze({sample(input){const sc=(input&&input.scenario)||{};const ts=(input&&Array.isArray(input.times_s))?input.times_s:[0];const g=Number(sc.g_m_s2);const m=Number(sc.mass_kg);const v=Number(sc.speed_m_s);const x0=Number(sc.x0_m)||0;const y0=Number(sc.y0_m)||0;const mode=String(sc.mode||'horizontal');const deg=mode==='horizontal'?0:Number(sc.angle_deg)||0;const rad=deg*Math.PI/180;const vx0=v*Math.cos(rad);const vy0=v*Math.sin(rad);const disc=Math.max(0,vy0*vy0+2*g*y0);const T=g>0?(vy0+Math.sqrt(disc))/g:0;const xLand=x0+vx0*T;const range=vx0*T;const tApex=vy0>0&&g>0?Math.min(vy0/g,T):0;const maxH=vy0>0&&g>0?y0+vy0*vy0/(2*g):y0;const den=Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,v*v+2*g*y0));const opt=g>0&&den>0?Math.atan(v/den)*180/Math.PI:45;const states=ts.map(tt=>{const t=Number(tt)||0;let x,y,vx,vy,ax,ay;if(T>0&&t<=T){const yy=y0+vy0*t-0.5*g*t*t;x=x0+vx0*t;y=yy<0?0:yy;vx=vx0;vy=vy0-g*t;ax=0;ay=-g;}else{x=xLand;y=0;vx=0;vy=0;ax=0;ay=0;}const ke=0.5*m*(vx*vx+vy*vy);const pe=m*g*y;const me=ke+pe;return {t_s:t,x_m:x,y_m:y,vx_m_s:vx,vy_m_s:vy,ax_m_s2:ax,ay_m_s2:ay,kinetic_j:ke,potential_j:pe,mechanical_j:me};});return {states:states,events:{flight_time_s:T,range_m:range,apex_time_s:tApex,max_height_m:maxH,optimal_equal_height_angle_deg:opt}};}});"}
